accepted: A class currently reads only first value moments; connected same-word products add information absent from a decoder of pooled means. Task relevance and quantum-specific benefit are unproven.
difference: Changes value statistic rather than scalar affinity, query generator, phase time or normalization; no reopening closed spectral/corroboration profiles.
qualification: Five new fixed1024 fits: Qcov/Qpooled-product/Dcov/Gaussian-cov/Gaussian-pooled-product, plus exact reused nativeQ/nativeD/Gaussian baseline controls. Qcov must beat all seven before full design.
rejected_claims: The bottleneck is established as the task cause
The covariance is a nonclassical resource
primary_boundary: No independent classical classifier residual or Gaussian-plus-Q mixture. All features use the same router; update only its readout statistic, shared stable training core remains unchanged.
reference: Bilinear CNN arXiv1504.07889 requires actual method reading; no novelty clearance
